website_summary.name: Maroon 2048 Game Hub
website_summary.description: The website presents a classic 2048 game interface with a maroon-themed design, featuring interactive tiles and a clean layout for gameplay.
website_summary.appearance: The website features a minimalist design centered around a 4x4 grid where the game is played. The background is a soft linen color, providing a neutral backdrop that contrasts well with the maroon-colored components. The title "2048" is prominently displayed at the top left corner in bold, accompanied by a "BETA" tag. To the right, there are score indicators labeled "SCORE" and "BEST," both styled in maroon with white text. The main game area consists of a grid of empty tiles, except for two initial tiles displaying the number "2." Below the grid, a "New Game" button invites players to start anew. Instructions for gameplay are provided at the bottom in a simple, readable font. All elements adhere to a maroon theme, ensuring a cohesive visual experience.
website_summary.functionality: The website enables users to play the 2048 game by moving numbered tiles on a grid. Players can initiate a new game using the "New Game" button. The game involves sliding tiles in four directions (up, down, left, right) to merge identical numbers, aiming to reach the 2048 tile. The score is updated dynamically as tiles merge. When no moves are available, the game ends, and players have the option to revive their game and continue playing. The site also displays the highest score achieved ("BEST") for reference.
